relationships.subject: Complete Freund's adjuvant
relationships.evidence_quote: the behaviors and calcium responses associated with Transient Receptor Potential Vanilloid 1 (TRPV1)-mediated histamine-dependent itch and Transient Receptor Potential Ankyrin 1 (TRPA1)-mediated histamine-independent itch were significantly suppressed by CFA treatment

relationships.subject: Complete Freund's adjuvant
relationships.evidence_quote: although both nociceptive Trpv1+ and Trpa1+ DRG neurons were increased after CFA treatment

relationships.subject: Complete Freund's adjuvant
relationships.evidence_quote: most known pruriceptors, including Hrh1+, Mrgpra3+, Mrgprd+, Htr3a+, Htr1f+, IL31ra+, Osmr+, and Lpar3+ DRG neurons, were significantly decreased

key_findings: CFA inflammation suppressed TRPV1- and TRPA1-mediated itch behaviors and calcium responses.
scRNA-seq showed nociceptive Trpv1+/Trpa1+ DRG neurons increased while most pruriceptor populations decreased.
